findings.issue: Construct רֹאשׁ (head/chief/top, no article) is smoothed as definite «lo principal», selecting the chief sense.
Absolute noun דְּרוֹר (a flowing / liberty) is rendered as the narrower property «fluidez».
H1314 is the spice/balsam substance (plural, then singular twice); «aromas»/«aroma» can be read as the scent alone.

notes: Person, imperative, 3ms suffix, 500 and 250, and the repeated fifty-and-two-hundred follow the tokens.
